WEEKLY EVENTS at THE PALACE

First Fridays at The Palace

The Palace is proud to offer free entertainment to the community on First Fridays. These concerts are for all ages and have open seating. Our cantina will be open for refreshment purchases during the entirety of all First Friday concerts.

If you want to see your band on our calendar for First Fridays, email us about open availabilities by emailing us at music@moviebowlgrille.com or fill out our Contact Form at the bottom of the page.

Your Gameday Destination in Downtown Bryan

College football is bigger than ever in Downtown Bryan!

Doors open at 11 AM with full premium food and beverage service.

Catch every play on our massive 10’ x 20’ LED video wall at center stage.

Keep up with the rest of the action on four 100-inch screens throughout The Palace.

Perfect for College football Saturdays and NFL Sundays! Grab your friends, order up your gameday favorites, and experience football like never before — only at Gameday on Main.

YOU CAN BE THE STAR

The Palace Theater hosts a weekly event that allows you to take center stage and showcase your talent!

Wednesday Nights are Open Mic Night! Hosted by Zachary Burnett, this music-filled evening provides a platform for new and up-and-coming local artists to showcase their latest songs and skills in front of a live audience. This is a free event for people to attend and perform. 7:00 - 10:00 PM each week.

Maroon & White Night

The City of Bryan and Destination Bryan invite you to enjoy an evening in Historic Downtown Bryan tailored just for you every third Friday at 6:00 PM.

All Texas A&M University and System employees, and their loved ones, are encouraged to experience live entertainment, vibrant art, local cuisines, unique bars and exclusive shops.

It’s a perfect opportunity to meet up with colleagues, make new friends, and enjoy a fun and relaxing night out.

Enjoy delicious food and drink specials at The Palace Theater (plus The Queen Theatre & Billy's Grille & Bar) during evening activities.
